title: Vilnius: City of Strangers
author: Laimonas Briedis
description: A history of Vilnius told through the outsiders who passed through it: crusaders, merchants, Napoleon’s retreating army, Russian officials, and Jewish scholars. The Gate of Dawn is the last of the old city gates.

title: Native Realm
author: Czesław Miłosz
description: The Nobel Prize-winning poet’s memoir of growing up in Wilno, as Vilnius was called when it was part of Poland, and studying at its university in the 1930s, in a city of Poles, Jews, Lithuanians, and Russians.

title: Promise at Dawn
author: Romain Gary
description: Romain Gary’s funny, moving memoir of his mother. A statue of the boy Gary, holding a shoe, stands near the house where they lived, recalling a scene from the book.

title: The Book Smugglers
author: David E. Fishman
description: The story of the Paper Brigade, the ghetto poets and scholars who hid Jewish books and documents from the Nazis, and recovered some of them after the war. The Nazis sorted the books in YIVO’s old headquarters.
